doc_documents.content: Kestrel-0 signed return policy. Ordinary goods have a 7-day return window. The complete exception list consists of two clauses: custom-made goods use exception CUSTOM-0-7c2; quality defects use exception DEFECT-0-9b4 and are exempt from the 7-day limit. Both exception identifiers must be retained when listing all exceptions. The old informal draft listed only DRAFT-0-2d1 and has no authority.
